_comment: AWI Resolve agent settings. This template ships pointing at the live Alpha Web connector, so a customer install works as-is once licenseKey and enrollmentSecret are filled in. For local development against your own machine, change orchestratorUrl to ws://127.0.0.1:8787 and clear enrollmentSecret.
_enrollmentSecret: The door key. Must match RESOLVE_ENROLLMENT_SECRET on the connector, or the agent is refused at enrollment.
_licenseKey: Paste the RSLIC1-... key issued by Create-License.cmd. Without it the machine still gets full diagnostics, but fixes and deployment are withheld.
_customerId: The organisation this PC belongs to. Scopes the usage console and the prepaid ticket balance.
_branding: Optional co-branding for the support window. The company NAME is taken from the licence (its brandName, or failing that the customer name) and cannot be set here — that is deliberate, so a PC cannot be dressed up as another company. The LOGO is local: set logoPath, or drop logo.png / logo.svg into a 'branding' folder next to this file. renewUrl is where the renewal reminder sends the customer; change it if you resell Resolve. Set enabled to false to keep the window purely Alpha Web branded.
